summary: Accepted. The sealed candidate makes exactly two source-date-context corrections and no other extraction change. Claim-428 correctly follows the explicit Tianyou 3 first-month anchor in s0276 and therefore records s0277 as Tianyou 3 first month / AD 906. Claim-466 correctly remains within the preceding Tianyou 2 eleventh-month sequence begun at s0245 and continued at s0251, retaining AD 905 while correcting its inherited source-date label. The candidate leaves the independently supported person hints unchanged and introduces no life chronology, translation change, or scope expansion.

sourceEvidence.quote: 三年正月，幽、滄稱兵，將寇于魏。
sourceEvidence.reason: The unit explicitly opens the third year, first month immediately before s0277.

sourceEvidence.quote: 魏人來乞師，且以牙軍驕悍，謀欲誅之，遣親吏臧延范密告於帝，帝陰許之。
sourceEvidence.reason: The Wei request and imperial assent follow the explicit Tianyou 3 first-month anchor; Tianyou 2 eleventh month is stale inherited context.

reviewedChanges.reason: Tianyou 3 is AD 906, so the replacement is source-sequence faithful and has the correct Western year.

sourceEvidence.quote: 十月丙戌朔，天子以帝為諸道兵馬元帥。
sourceEvidence.reason: This begins the Tianyou 2 autumn sequence.
This explicitly establishes the intervening eleventh-month sequence.

sourceEvidence.quote: 辛巳，天子命帝為相國，總百揆。
sourceEvidence.reason: The appointment remains in that established Tianyou 2 eleventh-month sequence; the inherited Tianyou 3 label is wrong while AD 905 remains correct.

reviewedChanges.reason: The replacement changes only the erroneous source-date label and preserves the source-supported AD 905 Western year.
